text: Lazing in a sunny afternoon, says Ray Davies, and for once the wheelhouse agrees. The Kinks, Sunny Afternoon. Gerrit's flat out on the roof.
Rain running down the wheelhouse windows. Jack Johnson, Monsoon. [dryly] I've put a pan under the leak and called it percussion.
A proper storm out there, and Django Django have a song for it. Storm. If the record skips, it's the boat, not the band.
Morning, coffee on, the lighthouse ticking over on the point. Elbow, New York Morning. It's a long way from here to New York, but the coffee's the same.
There's sunshine on the deck and Gerrit's pretending he isn't enjoying it. Matt Costa, Sunshine. Two and a half minutes, and then we'll both go back to sulking.
Snow on the wheelhouse roof and I'm wearing every jumper I own. Coldplay. Shiver. [deadpan] The title's a description.
Thunder somewhere past the lighthouse. Jake Bugg, Lightning Bolt. I've taken the aerial off the roof, so this may sound a bit thin.
Dark all round the boat, just the lighthouse sweeping past the window. The Weeknd, Blinding Lights. Every time the beam comes round, I blink.
First mug of the day, and I've already let it go cold. Galt MacDermot, Coffee Cold. A man should be able to drink his coffee warm. Not on this boat, apparently.
Late, and the whole island's asleep except the lighthouse and me. Aerosmith, Dream On. Go on then.
Clear skies, flat water, a fish for Gerrit. Lou Reed, Perfect Day. Don't tell him I said so.
